date_note: Date of the forum post, as given by Tech-ish Kenya (published 24 Nov).
title: A hacker claims to have stolen 600GB of identity documents from eCitizen (unconfirmed claim)
summary: Tech-ish Kenya reports that a forum user called ByteToBreach claims to have copied about 740GB from eCitizen: 600GB of KYC documents, plus 100GB of databases and 40GB of source code. The post went up on Sunday, 22 November. The outlet says it had seen no statement from eCitizen or the Treasury by midday on 24 November.
plain: A hacker says they took about 740GB of data from Kenya's eCitizen government portal. The claim is unconfirmed and no official statement had been seen.
exec: An unverified claim of about 740GB taken from a Kenyan government portal; no statement from eCitizen or the Treasury had been seen by midday on 24 November.
